_comment: Route numbers for the void highways. A key is the two regions a road joins, sorted and joined
with ~, which is the road's identity whichever direction it is driven. Baked into
client/shared/wildlands-field.js by scripts/content/bake-wildlands.mjs; nothing reads this at runtime.

types: what a stretch of highway is. trunk: the main road out of a region's gate to its hub, shared by every road through that gate. branch: a hub to another region. ramp: the slip road a branch leaves a trunk by. spur: a short dead-end road. half is the paved half-width in tiles, lanes the lane count (1-6), dirt whether it is unsurfaced, shield how its number is drawn.

A number may be shared by consecutive legs that chain THROUGH regions: Route 1 is the spine, Coldwater -> the Scarletwastes -> Terminus. `type` (a key of `types`) is what the whole road is built as, unless a hub makes part of it a trunk.

A road into an entrance that a hub road already reaches MERGES into that road and shares it from the join (plugins/trucking/state.js mergeInto): Route 4 from the Reach joins Route 1 short of the Scarletwastes.
